summary.headline: Modena Codices 12–13
summary.text: Catalog of Modena codices 12 and 13: codex 12 includes Ptolemy’s Apotelesmatika and Fruit, Porphyry on decans, fixed stars, terms, aspects, planetary testimonies, and lunar transits; codex 13, copied by Georgius Valla in 1488, contains the Almagest, geographical notes, the Fruit, and Petosiris’s letter to King Nechepso.
